title: itemprototype.get
description: Retrieve item prototypes according to the given parameters.

discoveryids.description: Return only item prototypes that belong to the given LLD rules.

graphids.description: Return only item prototypes that are used in the given graph prototypes.

hostids.description: Return only item prototypes that belong to the given hosts.

inherited.description: If set to true return only item prototypes inherited from a template.

itemids.description: Return only item prototypes with the given IDs.

monitored.description: If set to true return only enabled item prototypes that belong to monitored hosts.

templated.description: If set to true return only item prototypes that belong to templates.

templateids.description: Return only item prototypes that belong to the given templates.

triggerids.description: Return only item prototypes that are used in the given trigger prototypes.

selectDiscoveryRule.description: Return a discoveryRule property with the low-level discovery rule that the item prototype belongs to.

selectGraphs.description: Return a graphs property with graph prototypes that the item prototype is used in. Supports count.

selectHosts.description: Return a hosts property with an array of hosts that the item prototype belongs to.

selectTags.description: Return the item prototype tags in tags property.

selectTriggers.description: Return a triggers property with trigger prototypes that the item prototype is used in. Supports count.

selectPreprocessing.description: Return a preprocessing property with item prototype preprocessing options.

selectValueMap.description: Return a valuemap property with item prototype value map.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Accepts an object, where the keys are property names, and the values are either a single value or an array of values to match against. Does not support properties of text data type. Supports additional properties: host - technical name of the host that the item prototype belongs to.

limitSelects.description: Limits the number of records returned by subselects. Applies to the following subselects: selectGraphs - results will be sorted by name; selectTriggers - results will be sorted by description.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values: itemid, name, key_, delay, type, status, history, trends, discovered.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
